posts.author: EricWilsonTSBC
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I'm excited to introduce myself:
You can call me EricWilson! I'm the creator and founder of TenStudios Broadcasting Community. While we're mainly focused on media production, I have a passion project I'm working on—a game! I’d love to hear your suggestions, especially about scripting in Ruby, or just chat about game development.
My current project is called SSIA: Vanguard Chronicles. It's inspired by Wuthering Waves and Genshin Impact, but it has its own unique storytelling and an Elemental Counter system instead of reactions. I’ve shared more about it in the In Development section, so feel free to check it out if you're curious!
A little about me: I’m 22 years old, my MBTI type is ESTJ, and I'm from Jakarta, Indonesia. I’ve dabbled a bit in RPG Maker VX Ace before I fully purchased it on Steam.
It’s great to meet you all! Looking forward to connecting!
